propositions: 550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT (all LINK/AUTO-RECOVER), and 1 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit finding exist in the tickets store; remediation must eliminate repairable faults while preserving the intentional audit record.

A narrow --only=stale-channel selector must detect tickets whose latest snapshot lacks compiled_state.creation_channel and route them through batched, pre-tagged, commit-and-push repair, distinct from the broad --repair-snapshots path.
The stale-channel repair must refuse any ticket also carrying SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT or ORPHAN_EVENT findings to prevent incomplete full-log rebuilds of mixed faults.
Dry-run must report selected tickets and write zero files or commits; --limit=N must make repairs resumable by ticket count; push failure must abort before any later batch.
Unknown --only values and --only without --repair must exit 2 with operator-readable error; existing --repair and --repair-snapshots behavior must remain unchanged.
